Depth, access, visibility and the required result define the system. Start with the work your team needs to complete.

01 / INSPECT

Industrial Underwater Inspection ROVs

Choose an ROV around the inspection result you need, then work back through visibility, access, depth and sensor requirements.

Explore application02 / REACH

Underwater Tunnel Inspection ROVs

Inspection of flooded water tunnels depends on navigation, tether control and recovery as much as the vehicle’s rated range.

Explore application03 / CLEAN

Underwater Trash Rack Cleaning Robots

Evaluate contact cleaning of submerged intake and trash-rack surfaces against the deposits, rack geometry and support equipment.

Explore application04 / REMOVE

Sump Cleaning & Underwater Dredging Robots

For submerged sumps, a viable dredging system connects the vehicle to a pump, conveyance route and sediment-treatment plan.

Explore application05 / ASSESS

Underwater Dam Inspection ROVs

Use an inspection ROV to record the condition of submerged dam faces, intakes, gates and spillway structures, with camera and sonar matched to the water conditions.

Explore application06 / TRACE

Penstock Inspection Robots & ROVs

Penstocks and pressure conduits combine steep gradients, long enclosed routes and limited access. Robotic inspection needs a route-specific assessment of vehicle, tether and recovery.

Explore application07 / SURVEY

Bridge Pier & Port Underwater Inspection

Inspect submerged bridge piers, quay walls, piles and jetties with a compact ROV, using camera and sonar to record scour, damage and marine growth.
